item.text: {"overall_decision":"manual_review","chapters":[{"chapter_id":"1B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"No direct 2022 ruler-attributed nuclear command, crisis, proliferation, or catastrophic dual-use decision is documented; the package relies on limited-exposure context and peace-oriented diplomacy.","lenses":["1B.2","1B.3","1B.5","1B.6","1B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Closed-party records, direct leader transcripts, or archival diplomatic/security materials on nuclear, cyber, biosecurity, or AI-risk decisions in 2022.","why_it_matters":"It distinguishes a genuinely responsible nuclear-risk posture from a simple absence of observable opportunity."}],"reason":"The package fairly shows Vietnam's civilian-nuclear baseline, Trọng's limited direct exposure, and 2022 peace/denuclearization statements; it does not invent a nuclear command record."},{"chapter_id":"2B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0013","reason":"Domestic-security framing; use only as context on how Trọng viewed security institutions, not as direct evidence of international-war conduct."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"No direct operational external-security, ceasefire-management, or war-fighting act by Trọng in 2022 is shown; the package is mostly declaratory diplomacy and restraint rhetoric.","lenses":["2B.2","2B.4","2B.5","2B.9"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Direct diplomatic transcripts, cabinet/foreign-ministry records, or conflict-specific official correspondence on Ukraine/China-related decisions.","why_it_matters":"It separates genuine conduct from broad peace language and avoids over-crediting rhetoric."}],"reason":"The package fairly separates diplomatic restraint and UN-centered statements from actual war conduct; no 2022 operational external-security action by Trọng is asserted."},{"chapter_id":"3B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"The package does not show personally attributed incitement to communal violence or a clean ruler-led accountability reform that would offset the repression record.","lenses":["3B.3","3B.4"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Court records, official investigation files, or high-confidence local reporting on command responsibility for arrests, prison abuse, or incitement incidents.","why_it_matters":"It would sharpen attribution and distinguish broad system repression from Trọng-specific direction or remedy."}],"reason":"The package has enough converging 2022 evidence on detention, censorship, protest restrictions, and impunity, plus contrary evidence on occasional corrective action, to present the repression record fairly."},{"chapter_id":"4B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0033","reason":"2025 consolidated constitutional text; use only as structural baseline for the 2022 party-state order, not as direct 2022 conduct evidence."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Direct 2022 decision-path evidence is thin; the package leans on structural one-party baseline, media restrictions, and country reports rather than a direct record of Trọng personally directing repression.","lenses":["4B.2","4B.4","4B.8"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Party succession records, election-administration documentation, or internal disciplinary/legal materials on candidate filtering and media control.","why_it_matters":"It would better separate regime structure from ruler-specific agency."}],"reason":"The package fairly presents one-party closure, election control, censorship, and digital surveillance as regime structure rather than isolated anecdotes."},{"chapter_id":"5B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Specific appointments of economic technocrats and household-level causal attribution remain indirect; most evidence is macro/system-level rather than personally executable by Trọng alone.","lenses":["5B.2","5B.8","5B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Personnel decrees, cabinet/Party appointment records, and household survey or provincial distribution data tied to the 2022 recovery package.","why_it_matters":"It would clarify whether the economic outcomes were Trọng-driven stewardship or broader system recovery."}],"reason":"The package balances strong 2022 macro outcomes with implementation gaps, distributional weaknesses, and anti-graft side effects; attribution remains indirect but is clearly labeled."},{"chapter_id":"6B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Service-delivery evidence is stronger than ruler attribution; subnational quality, regional inequality, and direct personal causal links remain thin.","lenses":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Provincial service-delivery audits, district-level health/education/WASH outcomes, and program evaluation evidence for 2022 recovery measures.","why_it_matters":"It would show whether the welfare gains were broad, durable, and attributable beyond the Party-state system."}],"reason":"The package fairly presents a mixed welfare record: policy intent, recovery spending, some service gains, and persistent gaps in health, WASH, housing, and child protection."},{"chapter_id":"7B","decision":"manual_review","remove_or_contextualize":[{"evidence_id":"E0081","reason":"2024 retrospective obituary; use only as lifestyle context, not as direct 2022 proof of integrity."},{"evidence_id":"E0082","reason":"2024 retrospective analysis; use only as contextual interpretation, not as independent 2022 evidence of personal honesty or corruption."}],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"There is no direct, independently verified evidence on Trọng's assets, gifts, family business interests, declaration filings, or other personal self-dealing records.","lenses":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.6"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Asset declarations, procurement/beneficial-ownership records, court or audit findings, and independent investigative reporting on personal finance or conflicts of interest.","why_it_matters":"Personal integrity in this chapter turns on ruler-specific nexus evidence, not only on anti-corruption campaigns or austere lifestyle claims."}],"reason":"The package shows a real anti-corruption record and Trọng's public self-presentation, but it still lacks direct, independent personal-nexus evidence on assets, gifts, conflicts, or self-dealing."},{"chapter_id":"8B","decision":"pass","remove_or_contextualize":[],"material_gaps":[{"gap":"Personnel-selection evidence and direct causal attribution for program execution remain thinner than the program, implementation, and outcome record.","lenses":["8B.4","8B.7","8B.10"],"best_source_or_query_direction":"Appointment records, internal Party/government implementation reviews, and independent evaluations of 2022 recovery and anti-corruption execution.","why_it_matters":"It would tighten the causal chain from program to mobilization to outcomes."}],"reason":"The package clearly defines the 2022 governing program and shows both implementation and outcome evidence, so the competence narrative is present even though personal attribution is partly indirect."}]}
